name: Databox
summary: Centralized KPI dashboards. Pull data from all your software tools into one clean interface to monitor your business health. A free Skills Marketplace adds guided analyses on top: the paid-ads skill standardizes every ad channel into one efficiency table with CPA gauges against your own targets, judged per funnel role. A native MCP server (mcp.databox.com) puts those metrics inside ChatGPT or Claude — ingest data and query it in plain language. It runs on every paid plan, not on Free, and its queries spend from the same monthly AI-credit pool as Genie.
best_for: SMBs and agencies that want clean KPI dashboards from 130+ one-click integrations without building them by hand
skip_if: you need more than the three free sources but only a handful — the next step is Analyst at $71 a month for five — or you want deep custom data modelling, where a free tool like Looker Studio fits better
honest_knock: The pricing model bites, just not where it used to. The per-source fee is gone, and for some buyers that is worse rather than better: each plan includes a fixed number of data sources and going over means moving up a whole tier, so one extra integration can mean the $199 Team Core to $319 Team Scale step rather than $5.60. Only the Agency plan sells capacity piecemeal, in $20 client packs. AI credits are a shared monthly pool for Genie and the MCP server, so heavy AI use moves you up a tier as fast as data does, and 15-minute sync — once part of the top plan — is now a $14 per-source add-on on top of the subscription. Power users may also find the custom-metric and data-modelling depth limited next to a full BI tool.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-06, read on their own pricing page) Databox renamed and repriced its whole ladder since our August reading, so the Analyst/Pro/Growth tiers we described are gone. Free is $0 forever: 1 user, 3 data sources, 1 dashboard, 10 custom metrics, 50 AI credits a month, daily sync. Billed annually: Analyst $71/mo (1 user, 5 sources, unlimited dashboards and reports, 150 credits, hourly sync), Team Core $199/mo (3 users, 10 sources, 500 credits), Team Scale $319/mo (10 users, 30 sources, 1,000 credits, sub-accounts) and Agency from $79/mo (unlimited users, 4 clients, 20 sources, 300 credits), plus a quoted Custom tier. Monthly, Analyst reads $89 and the others $249, $399 and from $99; annual billing is 20% off. Databox states it does not charge per seat. Extra data sources no longer carry a per-source fee: each plan includes a fixed number and more means moving up a tier, except on Agency, which adds client packs of 1 client, 5 sources and 50 credits for $20/mo annually ($25 monthly). Add-ons are priced separately: branding and white-labeling $200/mo, advanced security management $80/mo, OKRs $160/mo, fiscal calendar $40/mo, 15-minute sync $14/mo per source, and flexible AI credit top-ups. Those add-on amounts are the annual-billing rates; on monthly billing the page shows $250 for branding, $100 for security management, $200 for OKRs, $50 for the fiscal calendar and $18 per source for 15-minute sync.
